name: Scrambled Text
description: Text that decodes from scrambled characters on scroll-in, then reacts to the pointer by scrambling or physically lifting, blurring or magnifying nearby letters, with a click shockwave.
contents: Single text block split into characters, with a screen-reader-only copy of the text
behavior: Intro decode: characters scramble and resolve at staggered times when the block enters the viewport
Pointer movement near characters triggers scramble, or a physical effect, depending on effect
Physical effects use eased falloff and trail smoothing driven by requestAnimationFrame
Click or tap emits an expanding wave that scrambles characters and pushes them outward
Scrambled characters can be tinted with scrambleColor
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by skipping the intro and physical effects
Waits for fonts to load before splitting and measuring
editableByProps: Effect style, strength, radius and trail
Scramble duration, speed, characters and scramble color
Intro decode and click burst on or off
Font family, text color, extra classes and inline styles

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the outer margin, max width or font size
needsCodeEdit.where: className string on the root div in the returned JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which effects count as physical or add a new one
needsCodeEdit.where: PHYSICAL constant and the paint function
IntersectionObserver rootMargin in the intro block
follow and attack constants in the tick function

fixed: Requires GSAP with the SplitText and ScrambleTextPlugin plugins, registered at module level
Splits text into per-character spans, so children should be a plain string for the animation to update on text change
Pointer based, so hover effects do not apply on touch; only tap burst works there
Root has fixed 7vw margin, 800px max width, monospace font and clamp(14px,4vw,32px) font size unless overridden
Single text paragraph only, no multi-element content

options.look: Letters near the pointer scramble into random characters and resolve back
options.useWhen: Hero headline or tagline that should feel like a hacker or decoding interface

options.look: Letters near the pointer rise upward with smooth falloff
options.useWhen: Calm about or intro paragraph that needs a subtle tactile hover

options.look: Letters near the pointer blur, fade and slightly enlarge
options.useWhen: Atmospheric statement text where a soft focus-shift hover suits the mood

options.look: Letters near the pointer swell and spread away from it like a lens
options.useWhen: Large display heading where the pointer acts as a magnifier
